details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{VC}^{*a}(\mathcal H)\leq2\,\mathrm{VC}^{*}(\mathcal H)+1$; equivalently $\mathrm{VC}^{*}(\mathcal H)\geq(\mathrm{VC}^{*a}(\mathcal H)-1)/2$.
proof: This is the second chain of Assouad-type bounds for antipodal shattering in Lemma 20 of the cited paper.
name: Dual VC Dimension / Dual Antipodal VC Dimension (affine)
